import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportPushforwardFiber
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FlatteningStratificationUniversal

/-!
# Fibre rank of a finite-support direct image

The rank of the direct image of a quasi-coherent sheaf with finite support
is the dimension of sections of the residue-field fibre, on arbitrary bases.
This supplies the numerical condition used by relative finite-support
flattening in the divisor-to-Grassmannian construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

open AlgebraicGeometry

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Isomorphic quasi-coherent sheaves have the same point rank. -/
theorem pointRank_eq_of_iso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (e : M ≅ N) (x : X) : pointRank X M x = pointRank X N x := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hx, _⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤) trivial
  let se : Γ(M, V) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V)] Γ(N, V) :=
    { toFun := e.hom.app V
      invFun := e.inv.app V
      map_add' := map_add _
      map_smul' := Hom.app_smul e.hom
      left_inv := fun m => by
        change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).app V m = m
        rw [e.hom_inv_id]
        rfl
      right_inv := fun n => by
        change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).app V n = n
        rw [e.inv_hom_id]
        rfl }
  rw [pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank M (V := ⟨V, hV⟩) x hx,
    pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank N (V := ⟨V, hV⟩) x hx]
  exact Ideal.fiberRank_congr (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal se

/-- Over a field, point rank equals the dimension of global sections. -/
theorem pointRank_spec_field_eq_finrank
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (M : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] (t : PrimeSpectrum K) :
    pointRank (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) M t =
      Module.finrank K ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of K)).obj M) := by
  letI : Module K Γ(M, ⊤) :=
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of K)).obj M).isModule
  rw [pointRank_spec_eq_fiberRank_gammaTop]
  exact Module.finrank_baseChange

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On an arbitrary base, a finite-support direct image has point rank equal
to the dimension of sections on the corresponding residue-field fibre. -/
theorem pointRank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0_of_finite_support
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)) (s : S) :
    pointRank S ((pushforward f).obj F) s = f.fiberH0 F s := by
  let K := S.residueField s
  let M := (pushforward f).obj F
  let N := (pushforward (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s)).obj (f.fiberModule s F)
  let t : PrimeSpectrum K := IsLocalRing.closedPoint K
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := pushforward_isQuasicoherent f F
  haveI : (f.fiberModule s F).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom (f.fiberι s) F inferInstance
  haveI : QuasiSeparated (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : QuasiSeparated f)
  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pushforward_isQuasicoherent _ _
  haveI : ((pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom _ M inferInstance
  let e : (pullback (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).obj M ≅ N :=
    pullbackPushforwardIso_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)) F hfin
  have hr : pointRank S M s = pointRank (Spec K) N t := by
    rw [← pointRank_eq_of_iso e t, pointRank_pullback]
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply]
  rw [hr]
  change pointRank (Spec (CommRingCat.of (S.residueField s))) N t = _
  rw [pointRank_spec_field_eq_finrank]
  letI := f.fiberSectionsModule s (f.fiberModule s F)
  let eΓ : ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := K)).obj N) ≃ₗ[K]
      Γ(f.fiberModule s F, ⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun m => m
      invFun := fun m => m
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r m => by
        change r • (m : Γ(N, ⊤)) = _
        rw [smul_gammaSpecTop]
        rfl }
  exact eΓ.finrank_eq

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
